subject: Portfolio Review – Position Concentration & Upcoming Retirement Drawdown
body:
Dear Mr. Suphanburi,

I am writing to bring to your attention a matter concerning your portfolio that I believe warrants a discussion at your convenience.

Our review has identified that the Pacific Rim Bank 4.75% Perpetual position currently represents 11.38% of your portfolio, exceeding our standard single-position limit of 10%.

Separately, I would like to note that your annual retirement drawdown of USD 1,450,000 is scheduled to commence in Q2 2027, with the first drawdown date on 1 April 2027. I believe it would be valuable to discuss how these two matters may relate to your broader planning.

As you had requested to discuss related deposit matters in person rather than over email, I would like to propose a meeting at your earliest convenience to review these points together in detail and discuss possible next steps.

Please let me know a date and time that would suit you, and I will arrange accordingly.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
